Definition: Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district
BiblicalUsage: Sheba is three men and a nation, all carrying one name. The genealogies list Sheba among the sons of Raamah, Job's friends watch for the companies of Sheba on the road, and the queen of Sheba comes to Solomon with hard questions and goes home carrying his gifts. The name means seven, or an oath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sheba shows how far God's name travelled. A queen from the ends of the earth came to hear Solomon's wisdom, and I hold that the nations still come when they hear that God is truly among His people.
